macros.name: capsdef
macros.doc: Add an entry to the database, which is of course nothing else than a TeX macro.

macros.name: capsreset
macros.doc: \capsreset clears the database and inserts a default rule.

macros.name: capssave
macros.doc: Save the current database in a macro within the SOUL@ namespace and let \capsselect restore this database.

macros.name: resetso
macros.doc: Let \resetso define reasonable default values for letterspacing.

macros.name: resetul
macros.doc: Set reasonable default values that fit most latin fonts.

macros.name: setuloverlap
macros.doc: Set the overlap amount, that helps to avoid gaps on sloppy output devices.

macros.name: so
macros.doc: The base macro for letterspacing is called \so.

macros.name: soulregister
macros.doc: Register a font switching command (or some other command) for the scanner.
